annotations.title: Compare a brand's plans on Fleek

description: All plans on sale on Fleek for one brand, side by side and shortest first: Fleek's price, list price (MRP), saving, duration, the price per month for month and year plans, delivery (code or activation), and the brand page link. Brands and prices are those of the given country's store, in its currency.

country.description: The user's country: a name, an ISO code (US, GB, AE, IN) or a currency (USD, ₹). Brands and prices differ by country. Omitted means Fleek's global store, in USD.
